interface.name: ext_input_routing_manager_v1

description.summary: manage global input sniffing and routing security

interface.description: This interface enforces isolated input event routing in Athanor OS. Global key grab requests or raw input sniffing hooks MUST explicitly undergo Gatekeeper DBus authorization before being established.

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: global input grab request denied by Gatekeeper

request.name: request_global_input_grab

description.summary: request global keyboard shortcut or input sniffing hook

request.description: Requests global input capture across all surfaces. Triggers Gatekeeper authorization popup.

interface.name: ext_input_grab_v1
interface.description: Represents a global input grab handle. Emits granted or denied event based on Gatekeeper response.

description.summary: global input grab approved by Gatekeeper
global input grab rejected by Gatekeeper
